about.paragraph1: For the last two years, I’ve been building things on the web. But my perspective on what to build, and why, was shaped long before I wrote my first line of code.
about.paragraph2: I came into this field from marketing, though not the side you might imagine. My world was less about campaigns and more about patterns: analyzing market data, deciphering user behavior, and understanding the precise mechanics of how people find and use a product online. SEO and SEM are just applied psychology and problem-solving. You learn to listen to what the data is screaming, and more importantly, to what it's whispering.
about.paragraph3: That's the background I bring to every development project. Most developers can write elegant code; my focus is on building elegant solutions. There's a real difference.
about.paragraph4: When I architect an application with React or Next.js, I'm not just thinking about state management or component structure. I think about the user's journey that brought them there. I consider the semantic markup that gives our content meaning beyond the screen. I build high-performance web applications with an innate understanding of performance, because I know firsthand that a delay of even a half-second is a decision a user makes to leave.
about.paragraph5: A lot of talented developers get stuck on the tech: they build for the device. They build for the spec. But they forget to build for the human on the other side, and for the business objective that makes the project worthwhile. My experience allows me to sit at that intersection. I can translate a business need into a technical requirement not as an abstract concept, but as a lived experience. I've been the person asking for the data, and now I'm the person building the systems that provide it.
about.paragraph6: AI-powered web app, sleek front-end, Django admin, full-stack Node.js application — the question I always start with is the same: "What are we actually solving for?" The technology is a means to an end. The real skill is in choosing the right tool for the job and using it wisely, knowing what that job actually is.
about.paragraph7: I don’t just build things right. I build the right things.
about.title1: Building for the Human Behind the Screen

services.longDescription:
Every business has unique processes, workflows, and challenges. The software you use should reflect that. I build custom web applications that adapt to how your company actually operates, instead of forcing your team into off-the-shelf software. I work with agile methods, focusing on MVP and rapid feedback cycles, so you see value early and iterate based on real usage.

From CRM systems designed for your specific sales cycle to dashboards that surface exactly the metrics you care about, every project begins with a deep analysis of your business processes. The result is a tool your team will actually want to use, because it was built for them.

Using technologies like React, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, deployed on AWS with cloud-native architecture, I build modular, reusable components that make your solution reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain as your business grows.
services.text: Tailored web applications: CRMs, dashboards, and internal tools built with modular components and agile product delivery, fitting how your business actually works.
services.title: Business Custom Software

services.longDescription:
Artificial Intelligence is a competitive advantage when applied with purpose. I build AI-powered web applications that integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into your existing workflows in a practical, measurable way, without unnecessary complexity.

An intelligent chatbot that cuts support tickets by 40%. A recommendation engine that increases average order value. AI agents that automate complex, multi-step business processes. The focus is always on the business outcome, not the technology for its own sake. Every solution is designed with an AI-driven user experience that feels natural and intuitive to your team and customers.

I work with APIs like OpenAI, open-source LLMs, vector databases for semantic search, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures to create AI solutions that understand your unique business context.
services.text: AI-powered web applications and LLM integration: chatbots, AI agents, and AI-driven user experiences that transform your workflows.
services.title: AI Solution Implementation

services.longDescription:
A website is your most important marketing asset, not just a digital business card. I build web applications that load instantly, work on every device, and naturally guide your visitors toward the action you want them to take. Using modular components and clean frontend logic, every project is architected for maintainability from day one.

Every project is built around performance, optimised for Core Web Vitals from the first line of code. This means your site won't just look great. It will rank higher on Google and provide a fluid experience for your users. I follow agile delivery practices, starting with an MVP to get rapid feedback and iterating based on real user data.

From high-conversion landing pages to full-featured web applications with authentication, payments, and dashboards, deployed on AWS with scalable cloud architecture, I approach every project as if it were my own, with careful attention to detail and an absolute focus on performance.
services.text: High-performance web applications: fast, responsive websites with modular components that load instantly, work on every device, and turn visitors into customers.
services.title: Web Development

features: Full technical SEO audit (crawlability, indexation, architecture)
Core Web Vitals and page speed optimisation
Competitor analysis and strategic keyword research
Content strategy and on-page optimisation
Migration and redesign consulting with SEO preservation
Analytics setup and auditing (GA4, Search Console)
services.longDescription:
Having a great website is only half the equation. The other half is making sure the right people find it. My background in digital marketing, combined with deep technical knowledge, lets me offer a perspective that goes beyond conventional SEO audits.

Every audit starts with data: I analyse your site's technical architecture, user experience signals (Core Web Vitals), content structure, and competitive positioning. For web applications, I ensure every millisecond of load time is accounted for, because speed directly impacts both rankings and conversions. The result is a prioritised action plan that ties each technical recommendation to a concrete business impact.

I don't sell SEO magic formulas. I offer rigorous analysis, transparent recommendations, and implementations that respect search engine guidelines while maximising your organic visibility.
services.text: Data-backed audits, high-performance optimisation, and strategy to help your business get found and convert.
services.title: SEO & Technical Consulting
